_comment: Sprint 15 / Item C6 — gVisor MAGI (Multi-Agent gVisor Isolation) policy for vOS agent runtimes. Source: https://gvisor.dev/blog/2026/04/15/magi-multi-agent-gvisor-isolation/  Loaded by backend/sandbox/gvisor_loader.py and consumed by infra/k8s/sandboxes/*.yaml at deploy time. Do NOT inline secrets here — this file is committed to git.

magi._comment: MAGI = Multi-Agent gVisor Isolation. Each agent gets its own sentry+kernel process pair, so a sentry-side compromise does not give cross-agent access. April-2026 gVisor feature.

platform._comment: ptrace is portable but slow; KVM is the production default. systrap is the new April-2026 path used by MAGI.

network._comment: Use the gVisor netstack ('sandbox') rather than host-passthrough. Closes the kernel-network attack surface. Each agent gets its own loopback + a host-NAT bridge for documented egress.

filesystem._comment: Read-only root + writable scratch at /vos/agent/. Tmpfs by default; durable storage requires explicit operator opt-in.

syscall_policy._comment: gVisor's sentry already filters; this layer is the additional drop list for the kinds an agent should never need. Matches Sprint 14.1 RLIMIT_NPROC / RLIMIT_NOFILE caps.

limits._comment: Mirror the Sprint 14.1 SystemManifest values so a kernel-side reviewer sees identical caps.

attestation._comment: Mandatory: every agent's gVisor instance writes its sentry config hash + kernel measurement chain to the compliance store at startup, so an auditor can verify the runtime configuration matches what's documented here.

honest_scope_ceiling._comment: Items deferred to Sprint 16-17 or later, by design.
deferred: Per-agent cryptographic identity injection via WIMSE (Wave 2 — Agent 2)
Cross-agent A2A channel over gVisor netstack (Sprint 16+ — Wave 2 in the original roadmap shifted to Sprint 16 for the A2A item)
Live RTMR extension on sentry restart (today: rebuild RTMR from compliance log; ideal: kernel-coordinated extension)
